title: Since the S4 freeze, work-store writes bypass the file-based CI guards: the store accepted a non-milestone roadmap ref (NEWS-VETO-ARMB-READ 'L-NEWS', 11-15), and 528 of 977 build items updated since 11-10 have no file export for roadmap-map-guard / soak / pipeline guards to read; the weekly export (D5) is deferred to S7 (11-30)
note:
EVIDENCE: roadmap_map.py --check (reads the store) FAIL 'row NEWS-VETO-ARMB-READ: roadmap ref L-NEWS is not a milestone' at 18:20Z; fixed in the store by this audit (set roadmap=[M28], the family of NEWS-ALPHA-*), re-run ok. docs/claude/work/checklist/ last touched 11-15; no workflow runs 'work.py export --to-files' (grep .github/workflows: 0 hits). WORK-STORE-DESIGN § 7 says guards read 'the weekly export, or GET /api/bot/work/items; a failed read is could_not_look', and that was not done in S4. So roadmap-map-guard, soak-*-guard, pipeline-guard, operator-owed-guard and the rest pass in CI over a stale export. PROPOSED: (1) validate the guard rules that are field checks (roadmap ref in milestones.yaml, due_rule present, soak n_needed <= 2) at write time in the store API, so a bad write is refused where it happens; (2) until S7, the existing ict-work-digest timer runs roadmap_map --check + soak contract check against the store and raises one alert on failure. Check WSD-S4-FOLLOWUPS before building. DETECTOR: (1) is itself the detector. CHECK {command: 'roadmap_map.py --check against the store; work.py add with roadmap=["L-BOGUS"]', rule: 'check ok AND the bogus write is refused', resolves_when: 'both hold'}. 2026-11-19 AM-OPS-7 takes this row (manager). CHECKLIST-EXPORT-STORE-DRIFT is folded in here: 106 of 217 compared rows differ export vs store, because no export has run since the S4 freeze (11-12); CI guards read the export by design (run_guards.py:2901 WORK_READ_SOURCE=export); raw-file readers check_shadowed_features, pr_landing_hold_alarm, check_research_queue_ml_consumer. Approved plan (manager 10:17Z): daily export workflow (D5 pulled forward from S7) after #27153/#27214; dry-run on a branch, report every guard that flips on the true states as a finding; HELD PR for the workflow; catch-up export as its own data commit; the stale 'canonical: False / S1' string at src/web/api/routers/work_items.py:317 as its own small Tier-2 PR. Gates this adds: none. [2026-11-19 15:16Z AM-OPS-8] #27308 (exporter keeps terminal_reason and routed_to; WorkStore._update _absent) MERGED (875b8dc, 15:14Z). Trader restarted by the deploy; the manager reads the restart report ~15:32Z. This unblocks the daily export workflow PR and the catch-up data commit (next; backfill row STORE-EXPORT-BACKFILL-258). [2026-11-19 22:25Z AM-OPS-9] Manager decision 21:51Z (verbatim intent): the export must never be red. Exporter pre-checks each changed row with the guards' OWN code (roadmap-map, soak-contract, claim-basis, imported not copied); a failing row stays in the store, is left out of that day's export, and gets one deduplicated pipeline item (guard message + row id); everything else lands green; the next day retries automatically. export_base_at cutover in _header.json: rows with store updated_at <= it are exempt (old debt -> STORE-EXPORT-BACKFILL-258) and the three guards skip them, stated under 'Gates this adds or changes' (it narrows a check; no operator approval needed). BUILD IN PROGRESS on branch am-ops-9/work-export-precheck (AM-OPS-9). Not yet pushed or reviewed. [2026-11-19 22:50Z AM-OPS-9] Built and reviewed. Held PR #27517 (head a1c482e3657d10cd0996c7729543f4aa05643385). It adds a pre-check that imports the guards' own predicates, holds back and files a failing item, and retries it daily; a workflow work-store-export.yml (daily at 04:37Z); and export_base_at 2026-11-19T22:30:00Z. DESIGN CHANGE put to the manager: the stamps side file docs/claude/work/EXPORT-STAMPS.json, holding the store updated_at plus sha256, because exported files carry no updated_at. RESIDUAL put to the manager: a forged pre-cutover stamp would exempt a file; closing that needs a new gate, so not done. Dry run against the store (build agent): 266 failing items, all pre-cutover, 0 held back; the first run lands about 1083 row files and 596 record files. Merged, not deployed and not observed until the first workflow run lands a green bot PR. [2026-11-19 23:40Z AM-OPS-9] Rotated to AM-OPS-10 (session_01AFoLuJvENzG66GcgnCTd2z) on manager instruction; full state is in the handoff message. [2026-11-20 00:44Z AM-OPS-10] PR #27517 MERGED at about 00:42:45Z (head f20d02d4f69310d0fb55bbf6e9723a8f341554ce). The manager dispatched the first work-store-export run: 44648031388 (workflow_dispatch, 00:42:50Z, sha 7c2085e845), in progress. Watching it. Expected: about 1084 row files and 598 records written, 0-1 held (PI-20261119-K7ZSW5Z7-0005, maybe 0 since ML-13's fix), validation passes, and the bot PR lands green. [2026-11-20 01:55Z AM-OPS-10] FIRST EXPORT RUN 44648031388: validation PASSED, but its bot PR #27549 (head fc696077) is RED in full CI, so nothing landed and main is unaffected.
- The two failures sat outside the validation's hand-picked set.
- redate-guard refused 13 records, all pre-cutover store writes. The 0001-01-01 is next_due_date's date.min, not a serialisation artifact.
- test_inbox_items_carry_options_key asserted that the live register holds an operator_decision edge; it holds none since DESK-18D-JUDGE-2 went queued on 11-17.
- Fidelity: 2019 rows exported against 1398 on main; no note dropped among the 1398 present on both.
FIX: PR #27571 (Tier 1 HOLD, head 760adb54). The pre-check also runs redate, with pre-cutover forgiveness. Validation runs CI's relevance guard set (excluding pr-landing-guard: commit-to-main writes its declaration after validation) plus every register-reading test, derived (77 files, 1,890 tests). The inbox test now uses a fixture.
DRY RUN on #27549's tree with the fix overlaid: guards PASS 58 · FAIL 1 (pr-landing, now excluded) · COULD-NOT-RUN 0.
NEXT: merge #27571, re-dispatch the export, and once its bot PR is green, close #27549 naming the replacement. Run 44648031388 will time out red in its merge wait at about 02:11Z (the intended single flag).
